name: Jasmine Technology Solution Public Company Limited
summary: Jasmine Technology Solution Public Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the design and installation of telecommunication systems, telecom services, bitcoin mining, generative AI, and other businesses in Thailand. The company offers computer system design and software development services; sells computer products; and offers cloud computing services. It also provides internet services; international telecommunications services; domestic and international leased circuit and data communication services; Cloud AI, Internet of Things, and FinTech; and engineering design and consultancy services for energy management and clean energy systems.
